decision.reason: The ledger incorrectly assumed that the existing Swedish consolidated source included Superettan. It contains Allsvenskan only, and no separate Superettan artifact exists in the complete repository tree.

Persist raw files and SHA-256 provenance.
Verify fixture identity, 16-club/240-match/30-appearance phase structure, closing-field completeness and playoff separation without outcome-based selection.
